Let <MATH_0001> be a Noetherian ring, let <MATH_0002> be a finite <MATH_0003>-module which
is annihilated by an integer <MATH_0004>, let <MATH_0005> be an algebraically closed field,
let <MATH_0006> be a separated, finite type scheme of dimension <MATH_0007> over <MATH_0008>, and
let <MATH_0009> be an open immersion. Then
<STRUCT_0002>
<STRUCT_0003> <MATH_0010> is a finite <MATH_0011>-module
if <MATH_0012> is prime to <MATH_0013>,
<STRUCT_0004> <MATH_0014> is a finite <MATH_0015>-module
if <MATH_0016> is proper.
<STRUCT_0005>
<STRUCT_0006>

<STRUCT_0001>
<LOCKED_0001>
Let <MATH_0001> be a Noetherian ring, let <MATH_0002> be an algebraically closed field,
let <MATH_0003> be a separated finite type scheme over <MATH_0004> of dimension <MATH_0005>, and
let <MATH_0006>
be a short exact sequence of sheaves of <MATH_0007>-modules on <MATH_0008>. If
<MATH_0009>, <MATH_0010> are finite <MATH_0011>-modules
then <MATH_0012> is a finite <MATH_0013>-module.
<STRUCT_0002>

<STRUCT_0001>
Since <MATH_0001> there is an open <MATH_0002> which is disjoint from
<MATH_0003> such that <MATH_0004> is dense open in <MATH_0005> (details omitted).
If <MATH_0006> denotes the inclusion morphism, then we see that
<MATH_0007> is a direct summand of <MATH_0008>.
Hence it suffices to prove the lemma in case <MATH_0009> is open and dense in <MATH_0010>.
This case follows from Lemmas <REF_0001>
and <REF_0002>.
<STRUCT_0002>

<STRUCT_0001>
Immediate from the long exact sequence of cohomology.

translation: 由于<MATH_0001>，存在开集（open）<MATH_0002>，它与<MATH_0003>不交（disjoint），使<MATH_0004>为<MATH_0005>中的稠密开集（dense open）（细节省略）。若<MATH_0006>表示包含态射（inclusion morphism），则可见<MATH_0007>为<MATH_0008>的直和项（direct summand）。故只需在<MATH_0009>为开集（open）且在<MATH_0010>中稠密（dense）的情形证明引理。此情形由引理<REF_0001>和<REF_0002>得到。
